t: The calculation of what to save

b.x: It is not a prophecy. It is not a government table. It is an order for a life in Brazil: frequent, possible, rare. Outside Brazil the order changes, and so do the emergency numbers. It is not a reason to live in fear. It is a reason not to train the rare before the common. If the wish is to die, 188. If the body has already failed, 192. This page does not dial.

Prepare for what happens to ordinary people. Not for what frightens in the film. Three questions, in this order. Does it happen often? If it happens, does someone get hurt or die? Does a gesture made beforehand change the end? If all three answers are yes, it rises. If it is rare and exists only in the film, it falls. The intention of this site is to save lives. Even if it is only one. One life saved already made the whole effort worth it.

In Brazil, the body fails more often than the city ends. Stroke, heart attack, no breath, bleeding, a fall, and a street crash pass through a family. The gesture is to recognize early and call 192. It is not to perform surgery. The water rises every year in some neighborhood. Whoever leaves early, on foot, and does not drive through the water, does not become a number. After the flood, disease kills more than the first day’s hunger. Dengue, leptospirosis, a dirty hand. A blackout of a few hours, sometimes of days, is common. What kills in it is not the dark. It is lighting the gas when there is a smell, using the elevator, and deciding in the dark. The street kills with politeness. A request. A second place. One yes too many. That is more common than the jungle. Three days without a market fit in a bag that looks like travel. A year of cans nobody eats does not enter this account.

You do not need to guess the year. What already happens comes back, and physics pushes a little further. Hard rain in a city built on a river. A week of heat, with someone alone in a closed room. A neighborhood cut off for a day, the market shut and the card not working. An older father who falls when nobody is there. A child who leaves sight for one minute. A phone with no signal. A disease that runs again. A wind that tears a roof. A quake is rare in most of Brazil and possible in some places. The gesture is short. It does not become a way of living. If there is conflict in the street, do not go look. Do not pick a side for the camera. Do not become a militia. None of this asks for another site. It asks for the sentence already here. Stay until the line says: leave. One light. Paper. Water. The real medicine. 192 if the body stopped. 193 if there is fire, a smell of gas, or a collapse. 190 if the violence is now. 199 if the house is in the water’s path.

It is not a home for fear. It is not an end-of-the-world hobby. It is not a number invented to frighten. It is not training the rare and leaving the stroke for later. It is not a weapon as a plan, nor flight from the law. Saving yourself is not abandoning whoever is at the table. The intention is to save lives. If the reader recognizes a stroke in the hour, does not walk into the water, or does not give the second yes on the street, one life was saved. It may be theirs. It may be the father’s, the child’s, the neighbor’s. One already made the effort worth it.
